stemMd: For real x with x not equal to 1 or −1, simplify (x squared−x)/(x squared−1).
explanationMd: Factor numerator as x(x−1) and denominator as (x−1)(x+1), then cancel x−1 where defined. The stated exclusions keep both original denominator factors nonzero.

distractorRationale.e: This keeps the wrong denominator factor.
distractorRationale.c: This cancels the numerator's x rather than the common x−1.
distractorRationale.b: This incorrectly cancels the whole denominator.
distractorRationale.a: This drops the numerator factor x.
